caseNameFull: In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF Dean George SKELOS.

opinions.text:
In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF Dean George SKELOS.

Dean George Skelos, of Rockville Centre, New York, is suspended from the practice of law in this Court and a rule will issue, returnable within 40 days, requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
